messages:
mai: Canary in us-west 2 failing health check after helm promote. Symptoms: service config not reading TLS cert.
raj: any logs?
mai: pod init: `tls: certificate file not found: /etc/certs/service.crt`
olivia: Chart 3.1.0 changed `values.tls.certName` -> `values.security.tlsSecretName` during PR #412. Looks like regional secret creation didn't pick up the new key.
ci-bot: Promotion pipeline shows post-canary job ran only on global leader, not on regional sync.
mai: deploy-bot shows canary paused. @deploy-bot status?
deploy-bot: Canary 3301234567-us-west paused for failing readiness probes. Action: hold and notify release-ops.
release-ops: decision: rollback chart regionally or pin values to legacy key for the region? Change window 15m.
raj: rolling back loses a critical bugfix. I prefer a local override. We can set `security.tlsSecretName=legacy-service-tls` in an overrides file and run a regional hotpatch.
olivia: agree, but annotate the release so we don't forget to unpin. Add `temp-unpin-by=3301238200` to release metadata.
mai: I'll run the override if you push it to deploy-bot. Command: `deploy-bot promote --env us-west --overrides overrides/usw-legacy-tls.yaml --annotate "temp-tls-pin"`
raj: queued job 3301234580. Preflight will check secret presence then apply override.
deploy-bot: Queued job 3301234580 by raj. Running preflight -> creating legacy secret stub -> helm upgrade with overrides.
ci-bot: preflight log: legacy secret present; post-upgrade checks starting.
mai: pods are coming up. readiness now passing, smoke tests starting.
ci-bot: smoke tests green. Canary healthy with override.
release-ops: decision recorded: regional override/pin applied, no rollback. Follow-up: secrets team to reconcile the new secret name across regions; schedule unpin after confirmation.
olivia: I'll add a PR checklist item: "If renaming secret keys, ensure regional secret sync and preflight validation included before promotion."
raj: will create a short runbook for manual unpin: command and verification steps.
mai: leaving annotation `temp-tls-pin` on release and note `unpin-eta=3301238200`. Closing thread once unpin completes.
